case: Compound SELECT output provenance over STRICT ANY
contract: A UNION ALL result over a STRICT ANY column and other branches retains SQLx fallback metadata rather than inheriting ANY from the first branch.
The same conservative metadata applies when the compound result is selected through a CTE or derived table.
Native typeof() reports integer, text and null for the three compound-result rows while the returned Value cells preserve those kinds.
Ordinary, bound-query and transaction paths retain the fallback metadata and exact values.
A direct ANY column remains declared ANY when an unrelated UNION appears only in its filter subquery.
